cohort: The study included 784 patients diagnosed with PPH who delivered at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University between December 2018 and December 2023, with an additional 338 postpartum women from the same period serving as a validation cohort.
finding: Parity of two or more, two or more abortions, in vitro fertilisation, gestational weeks at delivery, abnormal foetal position, caesarean delivery, pregnancy with anaemia, and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy were identified as independent risk factors for severe PPH, and the established predictive model accurately forecasts its occurrence.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was identified as an independent predictor of severe PPH.
